% Icons for behavior tree nodes (Sam, 2026-10-06: "icons generated by the
% tikz prompt"). Each icon is a macro that draws on a 10 x 10 grid in the
% color \IC with line width \IW; render.py sets both and scales the grid.
% A solid figure is the opponent ("it"); an outlined figure is you.
% Used by render.py for the icon images (web/icons/) and inside every tree
% figure (web/trees/), so the two always match.

% --- Shared pieces -------------------------------------------------------------
% A standing figure at (#1,#2), solid (the opponent).
\newcommand{\FigIt}[2]{\fill[\IC] (#1,#2+3.6) circle (0.75); \draw[\IC, line width=1.6*\IW, line cap=round] (#1,#2+2.8) -- (#1,#2+1.2) (#1,#2+1.2) -- (#1-0.6,#2) (#1,#2+1.2) -- (#1+0.6,#2);}
% The same, outlined (you).
\newcommand{\FigYou}[2]{\draw[\IC, line width=\IW] (#1,#2+3.6) circle (0.75); \draw[\IC, line width=\IW, line cap=round] (#1,#2+2.8) -- (#1,#2+1.2) (#1,#2+1.2) -- (#1-0.6,#2) (#1,#2+1.2) -- (#1+0.6,#2);}
% A sword from (#1,#2) to (#3,#4), with a short crossguard at the first end.
\newcommand{\Sword}[4]{\draw[\IC, line width=1.4*\IW, line cap=round] (#1,#2) -- (#3,#4); \fill[\IC] (#1,#2) circle (0.45);}
\newcommand{\Arrow}[4]{\draw[\IC, line width=1.4*\IW, -{Stealth[length=2.4mm, width=2.4mm]}] (#1,#2) -- (#3,#4);}
\newcommand{\Ground}{\draw[\IC, line width=\IW] (0.6,0.6) -- (9.4,0.6);}

% --- Tree shapes --------------------------------------------------------------------
\newcommand{\IconSelector}{\node[\IC, font=\sffamily\bfseries\fontsize{24}{24}\selectfont] at (5,5) {?};}
\newcommand{\IconSequence}{\Arrow{1.0}{5}{9.0}{5}}
\newcommand{\IconParallel}{\Arrow{1.0}{6.6}{9.0}{6.6}\Arrow{1.0}{3.4}{9.0}{3.4}}
\newcommand{\IconRepeat}{\draw[\IC, line width=1.4*\IW, -{Stealth[length=2.4mm, width=2.4mm]}] (7.6,6.4) arc (40:330:3.0);}
\newcommand{\IconSearch}{\draw[\IC, line width=1.4*\IW] (4.2,5.8) circle (2.4); \draw[\IC, line width=2.2*\IW, line cap=round] (5.9,4.1) -- (8.8,1.2);
  \foreach \a in {120,90,60} {\draw[\IC, line width=\IW] (4.2,5.8) -- ++(\a:1.9);}}

% --- Moves ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
\newcommand{\IconApproach}{\FigIt{2.4}{0.8}\Arrow{4.2}{3.2}{9.2}{3.2}}
\newcommand{\IconRetreat}{\FigIt{7.6}{0.8}\Arrow{5.8}{3.2}{0.8}{3.2}}
\newcommand{\IconGuard}{\FigIt{3.0}{0.8}\Sword{3.8}{2.8}{8.6}{4.4}}
\newcommand{\IconHighGuard}{\FigIt{3.0}{0.8}\Sword{3.8}{3.4}{7.8}{8.4}}
\newcommand{\IconLowGuard}{\FigIt{3.0}{0.8}\Sword{3.8}{2.6}{8.6}{0.8}}
\newcommand{\IconRaise}{\FigIt{3.0}{0.8}\Sword{3.8}{3.6}{4.6}{9.0}\draw[\IC, line width=\IW, -{Stealth[length=2mm]}] (8.4,3.6) arc (0:80:3.6);}
\newcommand{\IconOverhead}{\FigIt{2.6}{0.8}\draw[\IC, line width=1.4*\IW, -{Stealth[length=2.4mm, width=2.4mm]}] (3.0,8.6) arc (110:-20:4.4);}
\newcommand{\IconLowSweep}{\FigIt{2.6}{2.2}\draw[\IC, line width=1.4*\IW, -{Stealth[length=2.4mm, width=2.4mm]}] (3.0,1.8) arc (200:340:3.2);}
\newcommand{\IconThrust}{\FigIt{2.2}{0.8}\Sword{3.0}{3.0}{9.2}{3.0}\draw[\IC, line width=\IW] (6.0,4.2) -- (8.0,4.2) (6.0,1.8) -- (8.0,1.8);}
\newcommand{\IconSpin}{\draw[\IC, line width=1.4*\IW, -{Stealth[length=2.4mm, width=2.4mm]}] (8.4,5.0) arc (0:300:3.4); \Sword{5.0}{5.0}{7.6}{7.6}}
\newcommand{\IconJumpStrike}{\FigIt{3.0}{3.6}\Ground\Arrow{3.0}{1.2}{3.0}{3.2}\draw[\IC, line width=1.4*\IW, -{Stealth[length=2.4mm]}] (4.2,8.6) arc (110:10:3.4);}
\newcommand{\IconBounceStrike}{\FigIt{2.4}{3.4}\Ground\draw[\IC, line width=\IW] (5.0,1.0) -- (6.2,4.2) -- (7.4,1.0) -- (8.6,5.4);}
\newcommand{\IconDodgeAway}{\FigIt{6.8}{0.8}\draw[\IC, line width=1.4*\IW, dash pattern=on 3pt off 2pt, -{Stealth[length=2.4mm]}] (5.4,3.2) -- (0.8,3.2);}
\newcommand{\IconDodgeIn}{\FigIt{3.2}{0.8}\draw[\IC, line width=1.4*\IW, dash pattern=on 3pt off 2pt, -{Stealth[length=2.4mm]}] (4.6,3.2) -- (9.2,3.2);}
\newcommand{\IconPogo}{\Ground\Sword{5.0}{4.8}{5.0}{0.6}\draw[\IC, line width=1.4*\IW, -{Stealth[length=2.4mm]}] (1.6,3.4) arc (180:20:3.4);}
\newcommand{\IconStand}{\Ground\FigIt{5.0}{0.8}\Arrow{8.2}{1.6}{8.2}{6.0}}
\newcommand{\IconWait}{\draw[\IC, line width=1.4*\IW] (3,9) -- (7,9) -- (3,1) -- (7,1) -- cycle; \fill[\IC] (4.2,2.2) -- (5.8,2.2) -- (5,3.8) -- cycle;}
\newcommand{\IconClimb}{\draw[\IC, line width=1.6*\IW] (5.6,5.0) -- (9.4,5.0); \Ground\FigIt{2.6}{0.8}\draw[\IC, line width=1.4*\IW, -{Stealth[length=2.4mm]}] (3.6,5.2) to[bend left=50] (7.2,5.6);}
\newcommand{\IconThrow}{\FigIt{1.8}{0.8}\Sword{4.4}{5.4}{8.8}{7.6}\draw[\IC, line width=\IW] (3.4,6.4) -- (5.0,7.4) (3.6,4.6) -- (5.4,5.4);}
\newcommand{\IconStill}{\FigIt{5.0}{1.2}}
\newcommand{\IconWatch}{\draw[\IC, line width=1.4*\IW] (1.0,5) to[bend left=40] (9.0,5) to[bend left=40] (1.0,5); \fill[\IC] (5,5) circle (1.3);}
\newcommand{\IconMirror}{\draw[\IC, line width=\IW, dash pattern=on 2pt off 2pt] (5,0.6) -- (5,9.4); \FigYou{2.6}{1.0}\FigIt{7.4}{1.0}}

% --- Conditions ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
\newcommand{\IconFar}{\FigIt{1.4}{1.2}\FigYou{8.6}{1.2}\draw[\IC, line width=\IW, {Stealth[length=2mm]}-{Stealth[length=2mm]}] (2.8,7.8) -- (7.2,7.8);}
\newcommand{\IconNear}{\FigIt{3.6}{1.2}\FigYou{6.4}{1.2}\draw[\IC, line width=\IW, -{Stealth[length=2mm]}] (1.2,7.8) -- (3.4,7.8); \draw[\IC, line width=\IW, -{Stealth[length=2mm]}] (8.8,7.8) -- (6.6,7.8);}
\newcommand{\IconThreatHead}{\FigIt{6.8}{0.6}\Sword{0.8}{6.2}{5.6}{4.6}\draw[\IC, line width=\IW] (6.8,4.2) circle (1.6);}
\newcommand{\IconThreatBody}{\FigIt{6.8}{0.6}\Sword{0.8}{3.0}{6.0}{2.2}\draw[\IC, line width=\IW] (6.8,1.9) circle (1.5);}
\newcommand{\IconAirborne}{\Ground\FigIt{5.0}{3.4}\draw[\IC, line width=\IW, dash pattern=on 2pt off 2pt] (5,1.0) -- (5,3.0);}
\newcommand{\IconGrounded}{\Ground\FigIt{5.0}{0.6}}
\newcommand{\IconOppAirborne}{\Ground\FigYou{5.0}{3.4}\draw[\IC, line width=\IW, dash pattern=on 2pt off 2pt] (5,1.0) -- (5,3.0);}
\newcommand{\IconDown}{\Ground\fill[\IC] (2.0,1.6) circle (0.75); \draw[\IC, line width=1.6*\IW, line cap=round] (2.8,1.4) -- (6.4,1.4) -- (8.4,1.0);}
\newcommand{\IconOppDown}{\Ground\draw[\IC, line width=\IW] (2.0,1.6) circle (0.75); \draw[\IC, line width=\IW, line cap=round] (2.8,1.4) -- (6.4,1.4) -- (8.4,1.0);}
\newcommand{\IconOppDodging}{\FigYou{6.0}{1.0}\draw[\IC, line width=\IW, dash pattern=on 2pt off 2pt] (1.0,3.0) -- (4.4,3.0) (1.6,4.4) -- (4.4,4.4) (1.0,1.6) -- (4.4,1.6);}
\newcommand{\IconInk}{\fill[\IC] (5,9.0) .. controls (5.4,7.0) and (8.0,5.0) .. (8.0,3.4) .. controls (8.0,0.4) and (2.0,0.4) .. (2.0,3.4) .. controls (2.0,5.0) and (4.6,7.0) .. (5,9.0) -- cycle;}
\newcommand{\IconChance}{\draw[\IC, line width=1.4*\IW, rounded corners=4pt] (1.4,1.4) rectangle (8.6,8.6); \foreach \x/\y in {3.2/3.2,5/5,6.8/6.8,3.2/6.8,6.8/3.2} {\fill[\IC] (\x,\y) circle (0.7);}}
\newcommand{\IconAlly}{\FigIt{2.4}{1.0}\FigIt{5.0}{1.0}\FigYou{8.2}{1.0}}
\newcommand{\IconOppAbove}{\draw[\IC, line width=1.6*\IW] (5.0,5.0) -- (9.4,5.0); \Ground\FigIt{2.4}{0.8}\FigYou{7.2}{5.2}}
\newcommand{\IconOppBelow}{\draw[\IC, line width=1.6*\IW] (0.6,5.0) -- (5.0,5.0); \Ground\FigIt{2.8}{5.2}\FigYou{7.4}{0.8}}
\newcommand{\IconLedge}{\draw[\IC, line width=1.8*\IW] (1.6,7.4) -- (8.4,7.4); \Ground\FigIt{5.0}{0.8}}
\newcommand{\IconOnLedge}{\draw[\IC, line width=1.8*\IW] (1.6,4.0) -- (8.4,4.0); \Ground\FigIt{5.0}{4.2}}
\newcommand{\IconArmed}{\Sword{2.0}{2.0}{8.6}{8.6}\draw[\IC, line width=1.4*\IW] (1.0,3.6) -- (3.6,1.0);}
\newcommand{\IconUnarmed}{\Sword{2.0}{2.0}{8.6}{8.6}\draw[\IC, line width=1.4*\IW] (1.0,3.6) -- (3.6,1.0); \draw[\IC, line width=1.8*\IW] (1.0,9.0) -- (9.0,1.0);}
\newcommand{\IconFirstRound}{\draw[\IC, line width=1.4*\IW] (5,5) circle (4.0); \node[\IC, font=\sffamily\bfseries\fontsize{15}{15}\selectfont] at (5,5) {1};}
